title: Scorpio Season 2026: What Changes for Every Sign
description:
Scorpio season starts October 23 — here's the energy shift for all 12 signs.
Find your sign in the timestamps and tell us in the comments what you're letting go of.

#astrology #scorpioseason #horoscope
why: Season-change videos had the highest views over the last 90 days and above-average watch time.

scenes.text: On October 23, the Sun moves into Scorpio — and the mood of the whole sky gets deeper.
Scorpio season is about truth, letting go, and quiet transformation.
Fire signs — Aries, Leo and Sagittarius — this is your moment to finish what you started.
Earth signs — Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn — expect honest conversations that clear the air.
Air signs — Gemini, Libra and Aquarius — your intuition is louder than your logic this month. Listen to it.
Water signs — Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces — this season feels like coming home to yourself.
Which sign are you? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe to AstroStarVibes for your weekly forecast.
